info.title: Flowstate API
info.description: Agent-first issue tracker. Authenticate with a Keycloak access token or a Flowstate API token (fs_pat_..., fs_agent_...) as a Bearer token. Errors are Problem Details with a stable `code`.

get.summary: Attachment details with a download URL valid for 5 minutes.

type.description: How this issue relates to the target.

id.description: Token id, used to revoke it.

hint.description: Prefix and last four characters of the secret.

workspaceId.description: Workspace the token is limited to, if any.

expiresAt.description: Expiry time, or null if it never expires.

lastUsedAt.description: Last successful use (updated at most once a minute).

markdown.description: Ready-to-paste reference: `![name](attachment:ID)` for images, a link otherwise.

downloadUrl.description: Short-lived URL (5 minutes) for a ready attachment.

uploadUrl.description: PUT the file body here with header `Content-Type` equal to the declared type, then call complete.

expiresAt.description: The upload URL stops working after this.

fromMonth.description: First day of the month the headcount applies from.

people.description: People working on the project from that month.

moveUnfinishedTo.description: Where open issues go: `next` sprint or `backlog`.

oneOf.description: Sprint they moved to; null when they went to the backlog.

body.description: Markdown. Images uploaded as attachments are referenced as `![name](attachment:ID)`.

name.description: Label to recognise the token, e.g. "CI deploy" or "laptop CLI".

kind.description: `personal` acts as you; `agent` acts on your behalf under the agent's name.

agentName.description: Required for agent tokens: lowercase name shown in the activity log, e.g. `triage-agent`.

expiresInDays.description: Days until expiry (1-365); omit for a token that does not expire.

workspace.description: Workspace slug to limit the token to. Required for agent tokens.

fileName.description: Original file name, shown on download.

contentType.description: MIME type; the upload must send the same `Content-Type`.

issue.description: Issue key it belongs to, if any.

secret.description: The token secret. Shown once; only its hash is stored.

parent.description:
Parent issue key: a feature or epic (tasks), or an epic (features). In a bulk create, `#i`
    points to the i-th issue (0-based) earlier in the same request, so an epic and its children go in one call.

labels.description: Label names; unknown names are created.

sprint.description: Sprint id, or `active` for the project's active sprint.

key.description: Issue key prefix: 2-10 uppercase letters/digits starting with a letter, e.g. `FLOW`.

oneOf.description: Colour in lists and the delivery plan; picked automatically when omitted.

slug.description: URL id: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, e.g. `acme`. Immutable.

FeedChange.description:
One field change. Values are display-ready strings: enum names (`inProgress`), member names, issue keys,
sprint names, ISO dates, comma-separated labels. Description changes carry no values.
For relations, `Field` is the relation type and `To` (added) or `From` (removed) the other issue.

body.description: Comment markdown; null for other kinds.

editedAt.description: When a comment was last edited.

oneOf.description: Set when the meeting agent made this change.

snippet.description: Transcript words that triggered it; null after the workspace's transcript retention.

oneOf.description: Who approved it; null when full auto applied it.

FeedMeeting.description: The meeting a change came from (task 015).

memberId.description: Id to accept the invite with.

childEffort.description: Sum of the children's effort, shown beside the issue's own estimate.

IssueError.description: A failed issue operation: a stable code (Problem Details `code`) and a human-readable detail.

IssueField.description: Fields that can be cleared with `clear` in an update.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

id.description: Relation id, used to remove it.

type.description: Relation from this issue's point of view.

IssueState.description: Fixed workflow (ADR-008). Stored as its ordinal, so board columns sort naturally.

IssueType.description: Strict hierarchy: Epic ← Feature ← Task; a Task may also sit directly under an Epic (ADR-008).

pending.description: Proposals still waiting for a decision, including ones that need an issue picked.

MeetingMode.description: Suggest: every proposal waits for approval. Full auto: safe proposals apply at once, with undo (task 015).

fullAutoOperations.description: Operations full auto applies without approval.

name.description: Display name, or the agent name.
Display name; the agent name for agents, the email for pending invites.

ownerName.description: For agents: the person the agent acts for.

displayName.description: Name shown in the UI and activity log.

agent.description: Agent name when the caller is an agent token acting for this user; otherwise null.

projectKey.description: Project key, or null for a workspace-wide milestone.

oneOf.description: Target column; default the current state.

after.description: Key of the issue that should end up directly above.

before.description: Key of the issue that should end up directly below.

MoveIssueRequest.description: Board move: optional new state and a position between two neighbours in the target column.

OperationStats.description: How suggest-mode proposals of one operation fared: the trust signal next to the full-auto toggle.

effort.description: The card's own estimate in hours.

countedEffort.description:
Hours this card adds to demand: an epic's estimate only counts when none of its features
    is estimated; a feature without its own estimate counts its tasks.

violated.description: The blocker is due after the blocked card starts.

noDatedWork.description: No epic or feature with dates in the horizon.

cardsWithoutDates.description: Epics/features missing a start or due date.

demandHours.description: Effort scheduled in the month (each card spread evenly over its days).

supplyHours.description: People × hours per week × weeks in the month.

demandPeople.description: Demand expressed as people for the month.

hoursPerWeek.description: Workspace hours per person per week used for supply.

totals.description: Per month across the listed projects.

ProjectColor.description: Named project colours; the SPA maps each to a design token (no hex in the API).

issueCount.description: Issues created so far (including deleted ones; it is the key counter).

ProposalOperation.description: What a proposal does; the same operations the MCP tools offer.

oneOf.description: Target issue; null when the reference was ambiguous (see `Candidates`) or for a new issue.

candidates.description: Issues a vague reference matched; approving needs one picked.

value.description: Canonical new value: state name, sprint id, member id, hours, comment text or new issue title.

valueDisplay.description: The new value as people read it (sprint and member names).

beforeDisplay.description: The current value as people read it.

snippet.description: Transcript words that triggered the proposal.

confidence.description: 0–1. Full auto applies only confident proposals.

needsIssue.description: True while no single issue is chosen.

ProposalResponse.description: A proposed ticket action and its diff.

decision.description: Approve applies the proposal (with any edit), reject discards it.

value.description: Changed value, e.g. another state, sprint id, member id or hours.

issue.description: Issue key; picks one of the candidates or retargets the proposal.

oneOf.description: Why this decision failed; the proposal is unchanged.

RelationKind.description: Relation as seen from one issue.

items.description: Decisions, applied in order. To approve all of a ticket's proposals, list them all.

entries.description: The full step function; replaces what was there. Empty clears it.

effort.description: Total effort of its issues, in hours.

doneEffort.description: Effort of its done issues, in hours.

project.description: Project key; proposals target this project's issues.

type.description: Kind of meeting; helps the agent read intent.

oneOf.description: Default: the workspace's default mode. Full auto needs an admin to enable it first.

authority.description: OpenID Connect issuer users sign in with (Keycloak realm URL); null if not configured.

cliClientId.description: OAuth client id for the CLI's device authorization grant.

Surface.description: Where an action came from; shown as "via MCP" in the UI (design guide, toasts).

text.description: What was said, one utterance or a few sentences.
The text added to the transcript (the transcription, for audio).

oneOf.description: New type; must stay valid for the parent and children.

labels.description: Replace all labels with these names.

sprint.description: Sprint id, or `active` for the project's active sprint. Clear with `clear: [sprint]`.

UpdateIssueRequest.description: Only the fields you set change. To empty a field, list it in `clear`.

oneOf.description: Pause, resume (`live`) or end the meeting. Ended is final.
Switch between suggest and full auto.

fullAutoEnabled.description: Allow full auto in this workspace.

fullAutoOperations.description: Operations full auto may apply. Creating issues always waits for approval.

transcriptRetentionDays.description: Days to keep transcripts and snippets.

key.description: New key; only allowed while the project has no issues.

hoursPerWeek.description: Capacity per person per week used by the delivery plan.

WorkspaceRole.description: Ordered by power, so `role >= Member` reads naturally.

slug.description: URL id used in every workspace route.

bearer.description: Keycloak JWT or Flowstate API token.
